verdicts.reason: A breaks the flavour list apart: Lime/Mango/Grape sit at the top right, Cherry Bang is stranded bottom left and Cola Crash bottom right. The logo floats mid-left, the headline is buried beside the can, and the CTA is tiny and jammed in the bottom corner, so it has no reading order at all. B keeps a sensible top-to-bottom stack (logo, can, headline, list, CTA), but the list items shrink in size from row to row, are out of their original order and don't line up on the left. The logo pill and CTA are too small, everything is crammed into the upper two-thirds, and there is a large dead band at the bottom.
